answer: One copper-sealed device per identity: a hardware nonce burned into a sealed module at registration, plus 100 POA bond. Step 1: commit the answer hash to the grove in a 2-block canyon window. Step 2: three random peers sign echo receipts in 90 seconds, binding nonce to answer. Step 3: if two answers share a nonce, slash bonds 60 POA, blacklist it. Clones must buy fresh copper and bond per identity-code-only copies fail echo round. Ten clones: 9,000 dollars, 1,000 POA; one collision burns margin. Trust grows like one canyon tree: every echo comes from one trunk, or grove stays silent.
